# Listening audio fixtures

Two short Audio Studio exports (MP3 and Opus) and their vocabulary snapshots
exercise real browser decoding and playback without depending on the user's
current export selections. These were copied from `RealJapanese/Data/Audio`;
the manifest retains generation provenance. `Adjectives.json` includes the two
recorded words and a third meaning for multiple-choice questions. Tests copy
these files into their disposable catalog and never generate audio.
